explanation: The blue cross travels along the outer border clockwise, two fields at a time, and changes colour in the order blue → yellow → black, repeating. The black square moves vertically along the second column, one field at a time, bouncing off the upper and lower boundary and returning the same way, and changes colour in the order black → yellow, repeating. The pink arrow moves diagonally upwards to the left, one field at a time, and when it meets a boundary it reverses and returns the same way, and changes colour in the order pink → orange, repeating. Continuing that from the fourth matrix gives the fifth matrix with the cross at R4C1, the square at R2C2, the arrow at R3C3, and the sixth with the cross at R2C1, the square at R3C2, the arrow at R4C4.
